div.head: Af 42.3
div.ab: Gif he ðonne ðæs mægnes næbbe, ðæt he hine inne besitte mæge, ride to ðam ealdormen, (⁊) bidde hine fultumes; gif he him fultoman nelle, ride to cyninge, ær he feohte.
Gif he ðonne þæs mægenes ne hæbbe, þæt he hine inne besitte, ride to þam ealdormen, bidde hine fultumes; gif he him fultuman ne wille, ride to cyninge, ær he feohte.
Si uim non habeat, ut eum intus obsideat, uadat ad aldremannum et querat auxilium. Si ei subuenire nolit, adeat regem, priusquam assalliat eum.
Gif he þonne þæs mægenes ne hæbbe, þæt he hine inne besette, ride to þam ealdormen, bidde hine fultumes; gif he him fultuman ne wille, ride to cyninge, ær he feohte.

If he however does not have [sufficient] force that he may besiege him inside, let him ride to the ealdorman and ask him for support; if he is not willing to give him support, let him ride to the king before he attacks.

If, however, he has not power enough to beseige him in his house, he shall ride to the ealdorman to ask him for help. If he will not help him, he shall ride to the king before having recourse to violence.

If he [the attacker] has not sufficient power to besiege him in his house, he is to ride to the ealdorman and ask him for support; if he will not give him support, he is to ride to the king, before having recourse to fighting.

Wenn er aber nicht dazu Macht hat, [nämlich] dass er ihn drinnen belagern kann, so ziehe er zum Ealdorman (und) bitte den um Hilfe; wenn der ihm nicht helfen will, ziehe er zum König [um Hilfe], bevor er [in Rache] ficht.

But if he does not have the power for it, [namely] to besiege him inside, let him ride to the ealdorman (and) ask him for help; if he will not help him, let him ride to the king [for help] before he fights [in vengeance].
